description: AI-generates a side page under a parent landing page. Async — kicks off the side-page generator and returns `{ success, operationId, operationRowId, pollUrl, sidePageId }`. This is the GENERATOR (POST /side-pages/generate) — NOT a row creator. Comparison-type briefs may run synchronously and return `sidePageId` directly with no operationId. Two body modes:   • freeform: pass `key` + `prompt` (+ optional `keywords`, `selectedSections`, `voiceProfileId`, `sidePageType`).   • brief: pass `key` + `brief` (structured outline) + optional `briefId` and `roadmapItemId`. Poll `get_job` until `state` is `completed` (or `failed`/`partially_failed`/`cancelled` on error).

autoAssignAssets.description: Auto-assign brand assets to image slots after generation

brief.description: Brief-mode structured outline. When set, this is the canonical payload.

briefId.description: Persisted SeoBrief ID — required for comparison-type generation

key.description: Side-page key (URL slug fragment under the parent LP)

keywords.description: Freeform-mode: target keywords to weave into the page

roadmapItemId.description: Roadmap item ID this side page is fulfilling

sidePageType.description: Defaults to 'landing'. Use 'comparison' only with a persisted comparison briefId.

name: generate_side_page
